title: 3-Year Treasury Note auction (January new issue) — the block's largest leg and the one that takes the biggest share of the SOMA rollover
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), fetched direct by plain curl 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes), the four FlateDecode content streams inflated page by page and rows rebuilt from Tm coordinates. The row reads verbatim `3-Year NOTE / Thursday, January 07, 2027 / Monday, January 11, 2027 / Friday, January 15, 2027`, with NO `R` against the page legend `R --denotes reopening` — so this is a NEW ISSUE, unlike the 10-Year and 30-Year legs of the same block. 1:00pm ET is Treasury standing coupon-auction convention and is NOT separately sourced. Filed estimate on the two limits this lane records: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep — the confirming primary is the 2027-01-07 coupon announcement. Discovered in the never-assessed initial research of treasury-10y-note-2027-01-12, 2026-09-09
notes: NAMED AND DELIBERATELY NOT FILED by treasury-10y-note-2026-12-08's initial research (2026-09-09) so a sibling could own it; this is that sibling filing it. WHY IT MATTERS TO THE FAMILY RATHER THAN JUST COMPLETING THE BLOCK: the 3-Year is the LARGEST leg of the mid-quarter block at $58B against the 10-Year's $39B and the 30-Year's $22B, so under the pro-rata SOMA split the 2027-01-12 ledger establishes it takes 48.7% of whatever SOMA rolls at the 2027-01-15 settlement — measured at exactly 48.75% on 2026-01-15 ($16.88B of $34.64B), 48.7% on 2026-07-15 and 48.8% on 2024-10-15, against an offering-share of 58/119 = 48.74%. With ~$26.21B of TIPS maturing 2027-01-15 (NY Fed SOMA holdings as of 2026-09-02) and a roll ratio that has been exactly 100.0% on all 16 non-zero coupon settlements since 2025-12-31, this leg's expected add-on is ~$12.8B on a ~$70.8B total accepted — the single largest non-competitive award in the block, and the one most likely to be misread as demand. It is not: bid-to-cover is computed on tenders and awards NET of the SOMA add-on, verified to three decimals on the last eight 10-Year prints, so the add-on cannot flatter the headline ratio in either direction. SIZE IS INFERRED, NOT PUBLISHED: $58B is the standing 3-Year grid size, flat since April 2024 on the same `maintain nominal coupon and FRN auction sizes` language the family's other ledgers chain to, and it becomes published on 2027-01-07. STRUCTURE: this leg opens a compressed Mon/Tue/Wed block (3-Year 01-11, 10-Year 01-12, 30-Year 01-13) all settling Friday 2027-01-15, against December's Mon/Tue/Thu — bracketed by New Year's Day Friday 2027-01-01 and MLK Monday 2027-01-18, both carried as holiday lines in the PDF itself. The session also carries 13-week and 26-week bill auctions, so it is not the day's sole supply event. Proposed as an estimate; symbols: [] and no house playbook is rates-keyed, so nothing here licenses an entry.
